{{Conjecture|legends}}
This [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''woman''', in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], had an affair with a married [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith]] [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Eldrak Korsin]]. This relationship produced a son named [[Devore Korsin|Devore]], although by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the child's birth, Korsin had left to return to duty and did not know of his son's existence. Eventually, Devore left to follow in his father's footsteps.<ref name="LTOTS: Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>
